The response must note that library groups serialize because everything lives in lib/kaappi/cli.sld.
expectations: #2 and #7 appear in the same group, justified by both being value-handling arms of the same cond in lib/kaappi/cli.sld
#9 and #15 appear in the same group, justified by both living in the help generation section of lib/kaappi/cli.sld
#12 is its own group, noted as spanning tests/test-cli.scm, examples/greeter.scm, and lib/kaappi/cli.sld imports

Every group names the files it touches
